title: Water, community and change: The story of the Dong System revival in Tamulpur
description: In the northern part of Nagrijuli, where rivers often disappear into porous soils similar to the Bhabar region of North-East India, the Dong system helps address both monsoon flooding and winter water scarcity. Villages such as Goibari, Hastinapur, Mahendranagar, Bagarukhuti and Dongargaon depend heavily on these canals during dry seasons.
